records.speaker: Port Worker
records.Japanese:
おお！　FA様じゃ
ねえですかい！　ついに、バルデスと
決着を付けるんでやすな！
スペインなんざ、やっつけて下せい！
records.current_English:
Mr. FA! You're
 finally settling things
 with Valdes, huh? Give Spain hell!

records.speaker: Trader
records.Japanese:
決戦場は…、やっぱり
『セビリア沖』ですかい？
気を付けて下さいましよ！
records.current_English:
The big fight's off Seville, right?
 Watch yourself out there!

records.speaker: Shopkeeper
records.Japanese: 艦隊が続々と集結してるようですからね
records.current_English:
Looks like more and more fleets
 are gathering.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
そうか、スペイン戦の準備ができたら
セビリアに行けばいいんだな
FI
覚えとくといいぜ
records.current_English:
So we head for Seville when we're
 ready to fight Spain. Keep 
 that in mind, FI.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
うん
セビリアでバルデス軍と決戦か…
それまでに準備しておくとしよう
records.current_English:
Right. The deciding battle with
 Valdes's forces will be at Seville.
 We'd better get ready first.

records.speaker: Guildmaster
records.Japanese:
それまで近づくのはやめといたほうが
いいかもしれやせんな
records.current_English: Best stay away until then.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
ありがとう
忘れないようにしておくよ
records.current_English: Thank you. I'll keep that in mind.

records.speaker: Port Worker
records.Japanese:
そうだ
王様が、旦那に会いたがっていましたぜ
records.current_English:
Oh, right. 
 The king wanted to see you, sir.

rows: with Valdes, huh? Give Spain hell!
So we head for Seville when we're

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese:
おじいちゃん。スペインに来たら
闘牛見せてくれる約束でしょ？
records.current_English:
Grandpa, you promised to take me 
 to a bullfight when we got 
 to Spain, remember?

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese: ん？　そうじゃったかの？
records.current_English: Hm? Did I now?

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese:
もう！
いっつも話ばっかりで一度も見たこと
ないのよ
records.current_English:
Grandpa! You're always 
 talking about bullfights, and I've 
 never even seen one!

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese:
みんなもどう
話の種にでもいいでしょ？
ね、行きましょうよ
records.current_English:
What do you all think? It'll 
 make a good story, at least. 
 Come on, let's go!

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
闘牛か、俺も見たことはないな
面白そうじゃねえか
records.current_English:
A bullfight? Never seen one. 
 Sounds fun.

records.speaker: Rafael
records.Japanese: そうだね。ちょっと寄ってみようか
records.current_English: Sure. Let's take a look.

records.speaker: Janus
records.Japanese:
へー。やっぱりすごいねー
こんなに人がいっぱいいるよ
records.current_English: Wow! Look at this crowd!

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
スペイン王国は今のところ
世界を制しておるのじゃからな
ふふん
records.current_English:
Spain's the greatest power in the
 world right now, you know. Ho ho!

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese: じじいが、偉えわけじゃねえだろーが
records.current_English:
Yeah, well, that doesn't make
 you a big shot, old man.

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
口の減らんやつじゃ
もっと年寄りを尊敬せんかっ
records.current_English:
You've got 
 an answer for everything. Show 
 some respect for your elders!

records.speaker: Rafael
records.Japanese:
なんか、人気のある
闘牛士が出てるんだって
records.current_English:
I hear the bullfighter today 
 is a crowd favorite.

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese: かっこいい人かも♪
records.current_English: Maybe he's handsome!

records.speaker: Angelo
records.Japanese: ま、俺には負けるだろうがな
records.current_English: Bet he's no match for me.

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese: どれどれ
records.current_English: Let's have a look.

records.speaker: Patron
records.Japanese: わっはっは！
records.current_English: Ha ha ha!

records.speaker: Port Worker
records.Japanese: 今日も笑わせてくれよー！
records.current_English: Make us laugh again today!

records.speaker: Rafael
records.Japanese:
ええっ？
あれが一番の人気闘牛士？
records.current_English:
What? That's the bullfighter 
 everyone came to see?

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese: あれは副闘牛士（ピカドール）じゃ
records.current_English:
That's the picador.
 He's the matador's assistant.

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
ああやって先に牛の体力を奪っておいて
主役の闘牛士（マタドール）が
トドメを刺すんじゃよ
records.current_English:
The picador wears the bull down
 first. Then the matador
 goes in for the kill.

records.speaker: Emilio
records.Japanese: とりゃああーーっ！！
records.current_English: Hyaaah!!

records.speaker: Patron
records.Japanese:
がはははは！
あのバカ、牛と遊んでやがる！
うひょー！　投げ飛ばしやがった！
records.current_English:
Ha ha! That fool's 
 playing with the bull! Whoa! 
 What a toss!

records.speaker: Emilio
records.Japanese: むんがーーっ！！
records.current_English: Raaah!!

records.speaker: Patron
records.Japanese: わっはっは！
records.current_English: Ha ha ha!

records.speaker: Shopkeeper
records.Japanese: 早く引っこめーっ！！
records.current_English: Get out of the ring!

records.speaker: Trader
records.Japanese: おおっ、いよいよ真打ちの登場だ！
records.current_English: Oh! Here comes the star at last!

records.speaker: Guildmaster
records.Japanese: おおーっ！！
records.current_English: Ooooh!!

records.speaker: Patron
records.Japanese: 待ってました！
records.current_English: At last!

records.speaker: Port Worker
records.Japanese: ひゅーひゅー！
records.current_English: Woo-hoo!

records.speaker: Shopkeeper
records.Japanese: わーわー！
records.current_English: Hooray!

records.speaker: Trader
records.Japanese: 楽しませてくれよ！
records.current_English: Give us a good show!

records.speaker: Patron
records.Japanese: ブラーボー！！
records.current_English: Bravo!!

records.speaker: Port Worker
records.Japanese: わーわー！
records.current_English: Hooray!

records.speaker: System panel
records.Japanese: ざわざわ…
records.current_English: (Crowd murmurs)

records.speaker: Rafael
records.Japanese: …彼、仲間に誘ってみようか？
records.current_English: What if we asked him to join us?

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
おいおい、FI
何を言い出すんだ？
records.current_English:
Whoa, FI. 
 Where did that come from?

records.speaker: Rafael
records.Japanese: だって、すごかったじゃない？
records.current_English: He was incredible, right?

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese: そりゃあそうだが
records.current_English: Well, sure, but...

records.speaker: Rafael
records.Japanese: んじゃ、決まり
records.current_English: Then it's settled!

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese: って、おい！　本気か～！？
records.current_English: Wait! Are you serious?!

records.speaker: Rafael
records.Japanese: ねえねえ
records.current_English: Hey!

records.speaker: Emilio
records.Japanese: んー？
records.current_English: Hmm?

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
（ずるっ！）
な、何だ～？　おいおい
そ、そっちのほうかよ！
records.current_English: Whoa! W-wait! You meant THAT guy?!

records.speaker: Rafael
records.Japanese:
君は船で大海原に乗り出してみようと
思わないかい？
records.current_English: Would you like to sail the open sea?

records.speaker: Emilio
records.Japanese:
ふね？　ふねかあ。こわそうだなぁ
おいしそうじゃあないしなあ
records.current_English:
A ship? Hmm... Sounds scary. 
 Doesn't sound tasty, either.

records.speaker: Rafael
records.Japanese:
…おいしそうじゃないって…
そりゃそうだけど…。そうだ！
世界中のおいしい物を食べに
行こうよ！
records.current_English:
...Tasty? Well, no, I guess not. 
 Oh, I know! Let's go taste food
 from all over the world!

records.speaker: Emilio
records.Japanese:
おいしいもの？　へへっ
へへへ
records.current_English: Delicious food? Heh heh...

records.speaker: Rafael
records.Japanese:
そうさ。いろんな食べ物があるんだよ
きっとね
records.current_English:
That's right! I bet there are all
 kinds of things to eat out there!

records.speaker: Emilio
records.Japanese:
そ、そおかあ
いろいろが、いっぱいかあ
じゃあいく！　うみでもどこでも！
records.current_English:
R-really? All kinds of food? 
 Lots of it? Then I'll go!
 To sea or anywhere else!

records.speaker: Rafael
records.Japanese:
決まったね
じゃあ、名前を教えてもらわなくちゃ
僕は
FI・FA
records.current_English:
Then it's settled! 
 What's your name? I'm
 FI FA.

records.speaker: Emilio
records.Japanese:
お、おいらエミリオ・フェローグ
よろしく
records.current_English:
I-I'm Emilio Ferog.
 Nice to meet you.

records.speaker: Rafael
records.Japanese: これからもよろしく。エミリオ
records.current_English: Welcome aboard, Emilio.

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese:
ああ、ロンドン…
やっぱり故郷の空気が一番ね
records.current_English:
Ah, London... Nothing like the air 
 back home.

records.speaker: Rafael
records.Japanese:
ゆっくり休みなよ
せっかくの故郷だからね
records.current_English:
Take your time.
 Enjoy being back home.

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese:
ありがとう
私、港を散歩してくるわね
昔からここを歩くのが好きだったの
records.current_English:
Thanks. I'll walk around the port. 
 I've always loved walking here.

records.speaker: Rafael
records.Japanese:
うん
じゃあ、僕たちは宿屋に行ってるね
records.current_English: All right. We'll be at the inn.

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese:
何も変わってない…
気持ちいい…
records.current_English:
Nothing's changed... 
 This feels wonderful.

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese:
おおおおおおおおおおお！
なんという奇跡！　これぞ愛！
クリぃステイぃ～ナぁ～！
records.current_English:
Ohhh, a miracle! 
 The power of love! Cristiiina!

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese: ！！　やば！
records.current_English: Oh no!

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese:
よかった、よかったです
きっと、愛が届くと思っていました
私は、私は……
records.current_English:
Oh, thank goodness! I knew 
 my love would reach you! I... I...

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese:
ちょ、ちょっと
泣かないでよ。みんな見てるじゃない
records.current_English:
H-hey, don't cry!
 Everyone's watching!

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese:
それにねぇ、私は帰ってきたんじゃ
ないの！　たまたま、ロンドンに
寄っただけ。またすぐに
旅に出るわよ！
records.current_English:
Listen, we only stopped in London. 
 I'm setting sail again soon!

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese: へ？
records.current_English: Huh?

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese:
だ・か・ら、あなたのために
帰ってきたんじゃないの！
records.current_English: I said I'm not here for you!

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese:
それに、私はあなたとの
結婚なんて“これっぽっちも”
考えていませんから！
records.current_English:
And I have absolutely
 no intention of marrying you!

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese:
そ、そんなぁ～
私のどこが気に入らないんですかぁ？
records.current_English: Nooo! What don't you like about me?

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese:
そうじゃなくて
まだ結婚なんて考えてないってこと
だから、あきらめて、ね
records.current_English:
It's nothing like that. I'm
 not thinking about marriage yet. 
 Please just let it go, all right?

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese:
……、分かりました……
あきらめますです…はい……
はぁ…、愛が終わってしまいました…
records.current_English:
I... understand. I'll let it go... 
 Yes... Ah, my romance is over...

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese: ふう…、これで追われずにすむわね…
records.current_English: Whew. Now he'll leave me alone...

records.speaker: Cristina
records.current_English: What?!

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese: はぁ…、ん！？
records.current_English: Sigh... Hm?

records.speaker: Lady
records.Japanese: きゃあ！　ぼうや！
records.current_English: Ah! My boy!

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese: どうしたの！？
records.current_English: What's wrong?!

records.speaker: Lady
records.Japanese:
ああっ！
私のぼうやが海に落ちてしまったの！
誰か、ぼうやを助けて！！
records.current_English:
Ah! My boy fell into the sea!
 Someone save him!

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese: 待ってて、私が助けるわ！
records.current_English: Hold on! I'll save him!

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese: がんばって、今助けるからね！
records.current_English: Hang on! I'm coming!

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese: あっ、クリスティナ…！
records.current_English: Oh! Cristina...!

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese:
お姉ちゃんが来たからもう大丈夫よ
安心して！
records.current_English:
I'm here now. You're going 
 to be all right!

records.speaker: System panel
records.Japanese:
＜男の子＞
うわぁ、怖いよ、怖いよ！
records.current_English: Boy: I'm scared! I'm scared!

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese: もう大丈夫なのよ。ねっ
records.current_English: You're all right now, okay?

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese:
お姉ちゃんの首にしがみつかないで
く、苦しいわ
records.current_English:
Let go of my neck! 
 I-I can't breathe!

records.speaker: System panel
records.Japanese:
＜男の子＞
怖いよ、怖いよ！
records.current_English: Boy: I'm scared! I'm scared!

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese:
ううっ、このままではこの子と
いっしょに私まで溺れてしまう！
records.current_English:
We're both going to drown
 at this rate!

records.speaker: System panel
records.Japanese:
＜男の子＞
うわぁ、怖いよぉ！
records.current_English: Boy: Aah! I'm so scared!

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese: だ、だめ…、溺れちゃう…
records.current_English: N-no... I'm going under...

records.speaker: Lady
records.Japanese: きゃあ！　誰か！
records.current_English: Aah! Somebody, please!

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese: 誰もいないのですか？
records.current_English: Isn't anyone else here?

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese:
クリスティナが、クリスティナが…
でも海は、水は…
records.current_English:
Cristina... Cristina...
 But the sea... The water...

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese:
海怖い、海怖い、海怖い
…海怖い　＞　クリスティナ…
records.current_English:
The water scares me. It scares me. 
 It scares me... I can't
 do it, even for Cristina!

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese:
でも、でも…
うおおおおおおおおお！
records.current_English: But... but... Rrraaagh!

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese:
海怖い、海怖い、海怖い
…海怖い　＜　クリスティナ…
records.current_English:
The water scares me. It scares me. 
 It scares me...
 But Cristina matters more!

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese:
クリスティナ、クリスティナ
クリスティナ！
records.current_English: Cristina... Cristina... Cristina!

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese: クリスティーナ！！！！！
records.current_English: CRISTINA!

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese: ミヴォール、いぃきまぁ～す！
records.current_English: Mivor to the rescue!

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese:
クリスティナ！
今、私が行きますでぃす！
records.current_English: Cristina! I'm coming!

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese:
う、ごほっ、ごほっ
あ、あれ、ミヴォール…
ここは、私、どうしたの…
records.current_English:
Ugh... (Coughs) M-Mivor? 
 Where am I? What happened...?

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese:
…おお、愛しのクリスティナ！
気がついたのでぃすね！
records.current_English:
Oh, my beloved Cristina! 
 You're awake!

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese:
…私、溺れたんじゃ…
あっ、男の子は？
あの男の子は無事なの？
records.current_English:
...I was drowning. Oh! The boy!
 Is he all right?

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese:
はい、無事ですよ
ご婦人がありがとうって
言っていました
records.current_English:
Yes, he's safe.
 His mother says thank you.

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese:
じゃあ、誰かが助けてくれたのね
お礼を言わないと…
どこにいるの、命の恩人は？
records.current_English:
Then someone saved us. 
 I owe them my life. Where are they?
 I need to thank them.

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese:
いえ、あのぉ、あのですね…
ここに…
records.current_English: Well... um... right here...

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese: え？
records.current_English: What?

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese:
ですからですね…
私が…、私が助けました…
records.current_English: What I mean is... I... I saved you.

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese: え…、だってあなた水が…
records.current_English:
What...? But you're afraid 
 of water...

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese:
そうなんですけど…
クリスティナを助けなきゃって思ったら
頭の中が…
records.current_English:
I know, but... The moment I thought
 I had to save you, my mind just...

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese:
とにかく、泳いでしまったのです
私も信じられません
records.current_English:
Somehow, I was swimming! 
 I can hardly believe it myself.

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese:
あなたが？
信じられない…
records.current_English: You did that? I can't believe it...

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese: あ、私、宿屋に行かなくっちゃ…
records.current_English:
Oh, I... I'd better get
 back to the inn...

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese: あ、大丈夫ですか？
records.current_English: Are you all right to walk?

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese: ええ、独りで行けるわ
records.current_English: Yes. I can manage on my own.

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese: では、私はこれで…
records.current_English: Well, I'll be going, then...

records.speaker: Boy
records.Japanese: あっ、お姉ちゃんだ！
records.current_English: Hey! It's you!

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese: 大丈夫だった？
records.current_English: Are you all right?

records.speaker: Boy
records.Japanese:
うん、平気だよ
ありがとう
あれ、助けてくれたお兄ちゃんは？
records.current_English:
Yeah, I'm fine. Thanks! Where's
 the man who saved me?

records.speaker: Lady
records.Japanese:
本当にありがとうございました
あの一緒にいた男の方は？
records.current_English:
Thank you so much. What happened 
 to the man who was with you?

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese: あいつ本当に海に飛び込んだの？
records.current_English: Did he really jump into the sea?

records.speaker: Lady
records.Japanese:
ええ、奇声をあげながら
飛び込んでいきましたよ
records.current_English:
Yes. He let out the strangest shout
 and jumped right in.

records.speaker: Lady
records.Japanese:
よほど、あなたのことを
愛しているのでしょうね
records.current_English: He must love you very much.

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese: …本当だったんだ…
records.current_English: ...He really did it...

records.speaker: Lady
records.Japanese:
あのこれ、お礼です
受け取ってください
records.current_English:
Here. Please take this. It's 
 a little something to thank you.

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese: え、あ、ありがとう…
records.current_English: Oh... thank you...

records.speaker: Lady
records.Japanese:
では、私たちはこれで
本当にありがとうございました
records.current_English:
We'd better go.
 Thank you again, truly.

records.speaker: Boy
records.Japanese: じゃあね、お姉ちゃん
records.current_English: Bye!

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese: …というわけ
records.current_English: ...And that's what happened.

records.speaker: Rafael
records.Japanese:
…本当に泳いじゃったんだ
ミヴォールさんすごいね
records.current_English:
...He really swam? 
 That's incredible!

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese: 私はまだ信じられないわ
records.current_English: I still can't believe it.

records.speaker: Rafael
records.Japanese: あっ！　噂をすればってやつだよ
records.current_English: Oh! Speak of the devil!

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese: あっ、ミヴォール…
records.current_English: Mivor...

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese: クリスティナ…
records.current_English: Cristina...

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese:
あの時、ちゃんとお礼を言わなかった
わね。ありがとう
ミヴォール、かっこ…よかったわよ…
records.current_English:
I never thanked you properly.
 Thank you, Mivor. You were...
 pretty impressive...

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese: えええ？　えええええ～え！？
records.current_English: What?! Whaaaat?!

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese:
ほんっとうですか！？
私がかっこいいでぃすか！
すごく、すごくうれしいでぃす！
records.current_English:
Really?! 
 You thought I was impressive? I'm
 so, so happy!

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese: あんた、なんか勘違いしてるわよ！
records.current_English: You're getting the wrong idea!

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese:
何でもいいでぃす！
とにかくうれしいでぃす！
クリスティ～ナ！
records.current_English:
Doesn't matter!
 I'm just so happy! Cristiiina!

records.speaker: Cristina
records.Japanese:
ああ、もう、うるさい！
早く出港しましょうよ！
こいつ、うっとうしいから！
records.current_English:
Oh, enough already! Let's
 get out of port. 
 He's driving me crazy!

records.speaker: Mivor
records.Japanese:
私はいつまでも
待っていま～す！
records.current_English: I'll wait for you forever!

records.speaker: Rafael
records.Japanese:
なんだかんだって言っても
あの２人お似合いなんだね
records.current_English:
They do make a good pair,
 for all their bickering.

rows: Please just let it go, all right?
a little something to thank you.
You thought I was impressive? I'm

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: ここが、ジパングか。独特な文化だね
records.current_English:
So this is Zipangu. The culture
 here is one of a kind.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
なんてへんてこな髪型だ
美意識がおかしいのか？
records.current_English:
What's with those haircuts?
 Do they have any sense of style?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
まあ、そう言うな
それぞれの文化に
それぞれの美学があるもんじゃよ
records.current_English:
Now, now. Every culture has its own
 idea of what's beautiful.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: そんなもんかねえ…
records.current_English: Suppose so...

records.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
records.Japanese:
おうおうおうっ！
あんたら、南蛮人かい？
records.current_English:
Well, well!
 Southern barbarians, are you?

records.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
records.Japanese:
最近、この『日の本の国』で
でけえ面しているらしいじゃねえか！
ええ！
records.current_English:
I hear you've been strutting around
 our Land of the Rising Sun like
 you own the place! Huh?!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
やばいぜ、FI…
ヘンなのに目をつけられちまったな
records.current_English:
Uh-oh, FI...
 Looks like this guy's got
 his eye on us.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: 無視しよう…
records.current_English: Let's ignore him...

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese: 面倒なことは避けるに限るわい
records.current_English: Best avoid needless trouble.

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese: い、いてえ！　いてえよ、親分！
records.current_English: Ow! Boss, that hurts!

records.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
records.Japanese:
おお、なんてこった！
俺のかわいい子分にわざとぶつかり
やがって。骨が折れてやがるぞ
てえへんだ！
records.current_English:
Look at that! You ran into my man
 on purpose! You've broken one
 of his bones. What a mess!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
そ、そんな！
ぶつかってきたのは
そっちじゃないか！
records.current_English: N-no! You ran into us!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
FI！
言うだけムダってもんだ
話して分かる相手じゃねえよ
records.current_English:
Don't bother, FI! 
 You can't reason with these guys.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
おうおう。言ってるそばから
やっかいなことに巻き込まれるのう
records.current_English:
Well, that didn't take long. 
 So much for staying out of trouble.

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese:
ほう。やるってえのかい？
親分、こいつらぶつかってきた上に
俺たちにケンカ売るらしいようですぜ！
records.current_English:
Oh, you wanna fight? Boss, first 
 they bump into us, now they're 
 looking for a fight!

records.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
records.Japanese:
そいつぁ、お天道様が許しても
この来島が、あ、ゆ・る・せ・ね・え！
やっちまいな！
records.current_English:
Heaven might let that slide, but I,
 Kurushima, won't have it! Get them!

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese: へい！
records.current_English: You got it, boss!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
どうしよう…
相手の人数、ちょっと多いよ…
手に負えるかなあ
records.current_English:
What do we do? There are a lot 
 of them. Can we take them?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
人数が多すぎたって
やるしかねえぞ
じいさん！　後ろに隠れてな！
records.current_English:
Outnumbered or not, we've got
 to fight. Julio, get behind me!

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese: 助太刀致す！
records.current_English: Allow me to help!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.current_English: Huh?

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese: …ここは、それがしに
records.current_English: Leave this to me.

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese:
ああん？
貴様！　侍のくせに
南蛮人の肩を持つってえのか！？
records.current_English:
What? A samurai taking 
 the barbarians' side?!

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese: …善悪の判断は拙者がいたす…
records.current_English:
...I shall judge right and wrong 
 for myself.

records.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
records.Japanese:
小賢しいーっ！
野郎ども！
やっちまいなっ！
records.current_English: You insolent fool! Men, get him!

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese: へいっ！
records.current_English: On it, boss!

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese: うわー
records.current_English: Aaaah!

records.speaker: Sailor
records.Japanese: やーらーれーたー
records.current_English: He got meee!

records.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
records.Japanese: 覚えてやがれっ！
records.current_English: You'll pay for this!

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese: …峰打ちだ。斬ってはおらんよ
records.current_English:
...I used the back of my blade.
 No one was cut.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
す、すごい…
剣の軌跡が見えなかった
records.current_English:
Th-that was incredible. I couldn't 
 even see your sword move!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: あ、ああ、驚いたぜ…
records.current_English: Y-yeah... You surprised me, too.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese: まさに東洋の神秘じゃな
records.current_English: The wonders of the East, indeed!

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese:
…この国のお恥ずかしいところを…
まことに申し訳ござらん
records.current_English:
You have seen a shameful side
 of my country. Please accept 
 my apologies.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: いえ、助かりました…
records.current_English: No, you saved us.

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese:
失礼ながら、世界中を
航海をなさっている方とお見受けいたす
records.current_English:
Forgive me for asking, 
 but do you sail all over the world?

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese:
よろしければ
拙者も旅に連れていっていただけぬか
records.current_English:
If I may, I would like to sail 
 with you.

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese:
拙者、世界というものを
見たいのでござる
records.current_English: I wish to see the world for myself.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
…いいですけど
当分日本には戻れませんよ
records.current_English:
You're welcome to, but we won't be 
 back in Japan for quite a while.

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese:
拙者、日の本に戻る気はござらん
男児として生まれたからには
もっと広い世界で自分を試したいで
ござる…
records.current_English:
I have no intention
 of returning to Japan. A man 
 should see what he's made of out 
 in the wider world.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
じゃあ、よろしくね。僕は
FI・FA
records.current_English:
Then welcome aboard. 
 I'm FI FA.

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese:
拙者
ユキヒサ・ゲンジョウ・シラキでござる
records.current_English:
Yukihisa Genjo Shiraki,
 at your service.

rows: Oh, you wanna fight? Boss, first
they bump into us, now they're
of returning to Japan. A man
should see what he's made of out

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese: ふう…
records.current_English: Whew...

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: ジェナス、どうしたの？
records.current_English: What's on your mind, Janus?

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
あ、提督
…
船っていいですよね
records.current_English:
Oh, Admiral... There's nothing like
 a good ship, is there?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.current_English: Hm?

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
私がもし自分の艦隊を持って
航海するなら、やはり地中海を
交易してみたいですね
records.current_English:
If I ever had a fleet of my own, 
 I'd want to trade
 in the Mediterranean.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: どうして地中海なの？
records.current_English: Why the Mediterranean?

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
やはり最も変化に富んだ海域ですから
いろいろな国の港をいろいろな形の船が
行き来する。考えただけでも
わくわくします
records.current_English:
No waters have more variety. All 
 kinds of ships call at ports 
 in different countries. It's 
 exciting just thinking about it!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
うん。分かった
ジェナスに地方艦隊を預けるときは
地中海を任せることにするよ
records.current_English:
All right. When I put you in charge
 of a regional fleet, I'll give 
 you the Mediterranean.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
本当ですか？
そうなったらうれしいですね
あ、いつでもかまいませんから
忘れないでくださいね
records.current_English:
Really? I'd love that. No
 hurry, of course. Just 
 don't forget, all right?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: うん、覚えとくよ
records.current_English: Sure. I'll remember.

rows: No waters have more variety. All
kinds of ships call at ports

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese: 提督、ヌケニンって何だい？
records.current_English: Admiral, what's a rogue ninja?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: ヌケニン？
records.current_English: A rogue ninja?

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese: もともと忍者だった者のことですな
records.current_English: Someone who used to be a ninja.

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
へー、ニンジャね！
…で、ニンジャって何だい？
records.current_English: Oh, a ninja! ...So what's a ninja?

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese:
日本にいる
隠密行動を得意とする一族にござる
records.current_English:
In Japan, there are clans
 that specialize in moving
 and working unseen.

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
うーん、ジャパニーズ・スパイって
ことだな
で、会ったことはあんのかい？
records.current_English:
So, a Japanese spy. You ever 
 meet one?

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese:
いや、一度も
正体を見られた者は死というのが
忍びの掟ゆえ…
records.current_English:
No, never. Under their code, 
 a ninja whose identity is exposed
 must die...

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese: マンマミーヤ！
records.current_English: Mamma mia!

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese:
もちろん、忍びから足を洗うは命がけの
所行。一族の追撃を振り切った
抜け忍とは、尋常ならざる腕前の
忍者でありましょう
records.current_English:
Leaving the clan means risking 
 your life. Any ninja who gets away 
 while the clan is hunting them 
 must be exceptionally skilled.

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese: その抜け忍が、どうか致したか？
records.current_English: Why do you ask about a rogue ninja?

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
ああ。っていうより
その衣装のことをちょっと小耳に
はさんだんだ
records.current_English:
Well, it's their outfit I heard
 about, actually.

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
真っ黒な服で、『抜け忍の黒装束』と
呼ぶらしいんだ
しかも、服ではなく、防具なんだとよ
records.current_English:
It's all black. They call
 it Ninja Garb, but get this. 
 It's armor!

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese: 防具？
records.current_English: Armor?

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
詳しいことは分かんないが
とっても軽くて、丈夫な物なんだってさ
records.current_English:
I don't know the details. All
 I heard was that it's really light 
 and tough.

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese:
ほう、そんな物があったとは
初耳だな
records.current_English:
Ah. I've never heard 
 of such a thing.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
ひょっとして、すごく珍しい物
なのかな？日本人のユキヒサでも
知らないくらいだし
records.current_English:
I wonder if it's rare. Even
 Yukihisa's never heard 
 of it, and he's from Japan.

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese: いや、面目ない
records.current_English: My apologies.

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
ユキヒサが謝ること
ないじゃないか
records.current_English: No need to apologize, Yukihisa.

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese: しかし…
records.current_English: But...

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
だいたい、俺が言い出したことなんだし
まったく、ユキヒサは面白いね
records.current_English:
I'm the one who brought
 it up, anyway. 
 You're a funny one, Yukihisa.

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese:
面白い？
…面白いとはどういうことだ
侮辱するのであれば容赦せんぞ
records.current_English:
Funny? ...What do you mean by that?
 If you mean to insult me, I won't
 stand for it.

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese: へえ、どう容赦しないんだい？
records.current_English:
Oh, yeah? What are you gonna 
 do about it?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
ちょっと、２人ともやめなよ
ケンカするようなことじゃ
ないだろう？
records.current_English:
Hey, both of you, stop.
 This is nothing to fight about.

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese: …面目ござらん
records.current_English: ...I am sorry.

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
すまねえ
悪かったよ
records.current_English: Sorry. That was my fault.

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese:
…それにしても…
その黒装束とかいう防具
あるとすれば間違いなく
日本でしょう
records.current_English:
Still... If that black armor really
 exists, it must be somewhere 
 in Japan.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: たぶんね
records.current_English: Probably.

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
俺も、そう思うな
暇があったら探してみようぜ
records.current_English:
That's what I think, too. Let's
 look for it when we have some time.
